meta.name: AKASHIC Retrieval Evaluation Set v2 - Alice
meta.description: 50 query-passage pairs drawn from the Obsidian vault and ingested documents. Covers vault setup, daily notes, operating manual, templates, INSTALL.md guide, and Handbook of Medicinal Herbs.
meta.purpose: Measure Recall@K, Precision@K, and MRR before and after each pipeline change — never tune without data.

cases.notes: Ambiguous — 'config.yaml' could refer to the AKASHIC config or the CLAUDE.md. Expect no clear match since config.yaml content isn't indexed as a document.
